span.p:
Reference
trajectory / mission
pd, vd, ad, jd, ψd, ψ̇d

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Position loop
ep = pd − p, ev = vd − v
PID: ac = ad + Kpep + Kdev + Ki∫ep
SMC: ac = ad + Λev + ks + K tanh(s/ε)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Thrust vector & attitude reference
f = ac + g e₃ + Dv/m → 30° tilt limit
T = m f·zB
φd, θd exact (PDF 9.6) · η̇d feed-forward

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Attitude loop
eη = ηd − η, ėη = η̇d − W⁻¹ω
PID or SMC → η̈c

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Wrench calculation
τ = I(Wη̈c + Ẇη̇) + ω×Iω + Dωω
torque clip → u = (T, τ)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rotor allocation
min ‖S(Mf − u)‖²
0.3 N ≤ fi ≤ 12 N

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vehicle dynamics
motor lag → M f
m v̇ = RTe₃ − mge₃ + FD + Fd
Iω̇ + ω×Iω = τ + τd

div.style: color: rgb(11, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
State / sensors
x = (p, v, η, ω) + noise
